mapper.insert: INSERT INTO completion_events (id, todo_id, idempotency_key, cycle_no, completed_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{todoId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{cycleNo}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.todo_id, c.idempotency_key, c.cycle_no, c.completed_at, c.created_at FROM completion_events c JOIN todos t ON t.id = c.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE c.todo_id = #{todoId} AND ORDER BY c.cycle_no ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_revisions (id, todo_id, revision_no, title, due_date, priority, estimated_minutes, tag_names, revised_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{todoId}, #{revisionNo}, #{title}, #{dueDate}, #{priority}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{tagNames,typeHandler=com.plandosee.diary.common.db.TextArrayTypeHandler}, #{revisedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.todo_id, r.revision_no, r.title, r.due_date, r.priority, r.estimated_minutes, r.tag_names, r.revised_at FROM todo_revisions r JOIN todos t ON t.id = r.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE r.todo_id = #{todoId} AND ORDER BY r.revision_no DESC, r.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reopen_events (id, todo_id, cycle_no, reopened_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{todoId}, #{cycleNo}, #{reopenedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.sql: WITH owned_todo AS ( SELECT t.id FROM todos t JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE t.id = #{todoId} AND ), history AS ( SELECT c.id, 'COMPLETED' AS kind, 1 AS kind_rank, c.cycle_no, c.completed_at AS occurred_at FROM completion_events c JOIN owned_todo o ON o.id = c.todo_id UNION ALL SELECT r.id, 'REOPENED' AS kind, 2 AS kind_rank, r.cycle_no, r.reopened_at AS occurred_at FROM reopen_events r JOIN owned_todo o ON o.id = r.todo_id )
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.kind, h.cycle_no, h.occurred_at FROM history h ORDER BY h.occurred_at ASC, h.cycle_no ASC, h.kind_rank ASC, h.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(h.id) FILTER (WHERE h.kind = 'COMPLETED') AS completion_count, COUNT(h.id) FILTER (WHERE h.kind = 'REOPENED') AS reopen_count FROM history h
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reopen_events r USING todos t, plans p WHERE r.todo_id = t.id AND t.plan_id = p.id AND p.user_id = #{userId}
